mining: motif-grouped episodes, MIN_SUPPORT=2; parameterized selectors (no literal paths)
match_rate: recipe matches when query-family terms + intent/family align + anchor resolves
execution: current-view re-derivation via existing engine; produced witnesses appended to `related` and pass through the Context Compiler
overhead: recipe lookup+match is a scoped in-memory scan + one sub-query per selector step — sub-ms to ms; no reparse
replay_equivalent: recipe store is deterministic over mined history
